setting.casual_explanation: This writes the current-user keyboard-layout toggle values that disable the built-in language-switch hotkeys.

setting.tradeoffs_overview: The bundle is explicit and reversible, but it still lives only in the first-party provider and is not yet a validated research-provider card.
setting.professional_notes: The current app still exposes this tweak through app/Services/TweakProviders/PeripheralTweakProvider.cs and engine/Tweaks/Peripheral/KeyboardTweaks.cs. The current engine tweak writes three coordinated values under HKCU\Keyboard Layout\Toggle. This record keeps the live behavior documented without publishing it as a validated research-provider card yet.
